method: exclude derived and duplicate lineage from direction
abstain when primary evidence is insufficient

non_directional_sources.REGIME: Context from the same technical series; not counted again.
non_directional_sources.AGENT_BULL: Derived interpretation; never an independent vote.
non_directional_sources.AGENT_BEAR: Derived interpretation; never an independent vote.
non_directional_sources.AGENT_RISK: May lower support and add warnings; never flips direction.
non_directional_sources.DATA_QUALITY: Operational meta-evidence; never bearish or bullish.

strength_semantics: Forecast magnitude maps to support at 3 percentage points = 1.0; technical strength uses existing Phase 3 values; news uses absolute bounded impact. These are conservative rule-based values, not fitted probabilities.

risk_policy.HIGH_OR_VERY_HIGH: Caps support at LOW without changing direction.
risk_policy.pipeline_failure: Caps support at LOW and adds an operational risk without changing direction.

abstention: fewer than two usable primary sources
all relevant sources fail quality or freshness gates
calibration_status: UNVALIDATED; Phase 9 must evaluate historical utility without locked-test tuning.
